_comment: Natural submit rules shared by the Mac (MightyCore), Windows Core, the Windows page (vitest) and the phone (jest); docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-27-natural-submit-design.md, docs/interaction.md. Times are in ms; the rule's numbers are design-tokens.json motion.pendingShowAfter (150) and motion.pendingMinVisible (300), and scripts/check-design-tokens.js checks every display case against them.
displayRule: expectVisible means the pending/failed indicator area is shown. Pending: visible once it has lasted pendingShowAfter (now >= startedAt + showAfter); a pending that ended by then (endedAt <= startedAt + showAfter) is never shown; once shown it stays while pending and at least until startedAt + showAfter + minVisible (inclusive), then hides at once: visible while now < endedAt or now <= startedAt + showAfter + minVisible. Failed (`failed: true`; absent means false): before endedAt the action was still pending and follows the pending rule; from endedAt on the error shows at once and replaces any loading immediately, with no minVisible hold, and stays. A failed case always has endedAt (the failure); a failed state with endedAt null is invalid input, which readers treat as endedAt = now. Reduce Motion changes no timing, only the movement.

submitRule: outcome: the body's `outcome` when it is started, queued or steered (any other value is ignored); else its `accepted` when that is one of those words (old hosts); else null. accepted: true when outcome is not null or the body's `accepted` is the boolean true (then outcome may stay null). entryId, runId: the body's value when it is a non-empty string, else null. Other fields (protocol, draft, state) are ignored. New hosts keep sending `accepted` as the outcome word so older phones still read it. steered: the request went into the pane's running Claude process as a new turn (다음 실행 while the run only waits on background work, or a submit that lands that way); old and new hosts may both return it.

scrollRule: own (this composer's Enter, a queued request that now runs, 다음 실행, a selected ⌘Enter child): scroll toRequest in every view whatever the position, with resetBoard when the 파이프라인 shows an older board. Not own: today's follow rule, follow when nearBottom else none; on an older 파이프라인 board a not-own update is always none, on purpose (today's badge only, the user chose that board). resetBoard is only ever true for own submits. chosenBoard is newest outside the 파이프라인. The caller computes nearBottom with its own threshold (Mac 36 pt, Windows 32 px from the bottom; in 흐름 the follow camera being on; in 기록 and 파이프라인 being at the newest end); the fixture covers only the decision.
